blends.name: Chef Gaston, the French Bulldog of Cacao
blends.desc:
Meet Gaston, a French bulldog like no other. Small in size, but huge in talent, he’s the proud head of cacao cultivation on his lush tropical plantation.

Wearing his handsome woven straw hat, always perfectly perched on his head, Gaston patrols his cacao trees with pride, sniffing each pod like a true connoisseur. He knows every tree, every bean, every subtle aroma. Nothing escapes his expert nose!

His cacao beans are famous worldwide for their richness, deep fragrance, and unbeatable taste. Chocolatiers, pastry chefs, and sweet lovers all crave his harvest.

Proud of his land and craft, Gaston never compromises on quality. He often says:
"Great chocolate always starts with a great bean — and a great bean takes a great nose!"
